input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: The structure of Section 21 is otherwise strong: the cap is expressly mutual, indirect/consequential damages are mutually excluded (with restoration, replacement-service, notice and incident-response costs preserved as direct damages), Excluded Claims cover confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and the other Party's IP, and Customer's payment obligation is expressly not "damages". The cap quantum, however, fails the fallback: "Fees" is defined (1.5/1.6) as the Implementation Fee only — a one-time USD 12,000 charge under the first Order Form — so the twelve-month measure and the reference to "the first Order Form" reduce the cap to roughly USD 12,000 regardless of ongoing subscription and services spend. That is far below 6 months' fees and is an illusory cap in walk-away territory. Minimal fix: keep the sentence and mutual carve-out architecture, but measure the cap by all amounts paid or payable by Customer under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding twelve months, with a USD 1,000,000 floor (preferred position). We did not amend the "Fees" definition itself to avoid disturbing the payment provisions.

proposal.summary: Replace the illusory "Fees"-based cap (USD 12,000 implementation fee under the first Order Form) with the greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable across the Agreement and USD 1,000,000.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] As drafted the mutual cap is measured by "Fees", which the definitions limit to the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the cap is effectively illusory; we have reset it to the greater of twelve months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000, consistent with our standard position. Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) remain outside the cap.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
